aboutGame.title: What is Komorebi Prison?
paragraphs: Komorebi Prison is a multiplayer prison sandbox where every corridor is shared with other players. You spawn into a facility, learn its daily rhythm of roll calls, meals, work shifts, and lockdowns, then use jobs, trading, and reputation to build toward the one goal everyone shares: a clean way out.

The social layer is what sets it apart. Trust is currency, contraband moves through player networks, and the police and escapee mechanics keep the pressure on. Our wiki covers the beginner loop, fighting styles, escape routes, clothes and styles, prison mechanics, and community updates in one place.

modules.name: Komorebi Prison Beginner Guide
modules.description: A five-step Komorebi Prison beginner guide that walks you through your first sessions, from orientation to your first calculated attempt.

highlights.detail: Orient yourself: learn your cell, the yard, the exits, and the nearest guard post.
Follow the routine so you never draw attention by missing roll call or a shift.
Earn from a job or favor, then bank the reward instead of spending it all at once.
Build one or two reliable contacts who will vouch for you later.
Attempt a calculated shot at escape or promotion only when your resources are ready.

highlights.detail: Striking — fast punishes, easy confirms, and the lowest skill floor for new fighters.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Agility and footwork — controls spacing and escapes ganks, ideal as a second style.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Grappling — ignores blocking and applies huge pressure, but slow to start.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Weapon and defensive counter — highest burst or best reads, but fragile and punishing.

modules.name: Komorebi Prison Escape Guide
modules.description: The four phases of a Komorebi Prison prison escape, from scouting the perimeter to committing during a gap in attention.

highlights.detail: Recon: map the space, note doors, cameras, and patrol paths.
Acquisition: gather the tools and information your route depends on.
Conversion: combine, trade, or use tools to open a new area.
Execution: move through the opening during a gap in attention, not before.

faq.title: Komorebi Prison FAQ
faq.description: Straight answers to the questions new Komorebi Prison players ask most.

items.question: What is Komorebi Prison?
items.answer: Komorebi Prison is a multiplayer prison sandbox where you spawn into a shared facility, follow its daily routine, take jobs, trade, and work toward an escape. Every corridor is populated by other players, so trust and timing matter as much as your loadout.

items.question: Is Komorebi Prison free to play?
items.answer: Komorebi Prison is a multiplayer Roblox prison game, so you can join the experience for free. Codes, events, and in-game currency are the main ways to pick up cosmetics without spending anything.

items.question: Where do I find working Komorebi Prison codes?
items.answer: The in-game news panel and the developers' official community channels are the most reliable places to find Komorebi Prison codes. Always redeem a code in the main lobby, and treat any page that asks you to log in as a scam.

items.question: How do I escape in Komorebi Prison?
items.answer: A Komorebi Prison escape runs through four phases: recon the doors and patrols, acquire the tools you need, convert them into access, then commit during a gap in attention. Never fight in a place you cannot leave.

items.question: What are the best Komorebi Prison fighting styles?
items.answer: Striking is the easiest entry point, with fast punishes and a low skill floor. Agility and footwork are the best second style, while grappling, weapons, and defensive counters reward more experience.

items.question: Do Komorebi Prison clothes affect gameplay?
items.answer: No. Komorebi Prison clothes are cosmetic, but they signal your role and status to other players, which changes how they treat you in social and trading situations.
